canonical_project: Mauritius Telecom Rose Belle Data Centre (RBDC)
notes: MT/my.t colocation page (checked 2026-08-12) states the Rose Belle Data Centre in the south of Mauritius (Rose-Belle, Grand Port) provides 1,500 sq m secured rack space, 400+ racks and 3 MW of power; Uptime Institute lists Rose Belle Data Centre Phase 1 (Mauritius Telecom) with Tier IV Certification of Design Documents and Tier IV Certification of Constructed Facility. 3 MW is the operator-stated power figure.
